name: context-surface-analyzer
description: Deterministically measure and compare explicit Agent tool-catalog snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Measure and compare explicit Agent tool catalogs.
interface.longDescription: Analyze one bounded tool-catalog snapshot or compare two snapshots for exact canonical UTF-8 bytes, tool and schema counts, hard name collisions, exact duplicate schemas, declared budget checks, and matched caller-supplied token measurements.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this explicit Agent tool-catalog snapshot.
Compare these two explicit tool-catalog snapshots.
Check this snapshot for collisions, duplicate schemas, and budget overruns.
